sources.title: Evaluating Gemma 3 27B for local undergraduate physics tutoring - Springer
sources.snippet: The locally deployed model achieves high benchmark accuracy, although performance is lower and more variable on conceptual and multi-step reasoning tasks than that of a commercial cloud baseline. We subsequently deploy the same model as a tutoring chatbot in a classroom field experiment with first-semester engineering students.
